# Oversized Document

## Very Large Section

This paragraph contains a significant amount of text that is repeated multiple times
to simulate an oversized section that would need to be split during chunking. The
purpose of this fixture is to test the chunker's ability to handle sections that
exceed the maximum chunk size and need to be broken into smaller pieces.
